laneComparisonSummary: The 10 proposed attack-method bodies have identical queue sites and direct-root counts across lanes. Sethos skill differs only by a StellarConduct Energy-refund event listener. Varesa skill differs in the Go tag-field type used for Nightsoul. Mona asc/cons and Freminet cons have Stellar-specific reaction/Hexerei edits; neither changes proposed direct root counts. All other cited support files match byte-for-byte across lanes.

candidateAssessments.sourceEvidence: skill.go:38-86; 4 direct DoT queues in the loop at 60-63 plus one direct explosion at 77. hold=0/1 changes timing only; last explosion is frame 329/344.
candidateAssessments.audit: The method queues exactly four tick attacks and one explosion. particleCB at skill.go:89-103 adds particles only. Init at mona.go:51-63 installs A4 and constellation hooks; asc.go:21-63 A1 phantom damage is created by later dash actions. C2 follow-up CA listens only to later Normal hits (cons.go:104-140); C1/reaction and omen detonation effects are separate reaction or later-action scope. E contributes no extra callback-generated attack.
candidateAssessments.constraints: hold=0: ticks 86,145,204,263; explosion 329. hold!=0: ticks 101,160,219,278; explosion 344. Constant total 5; observe through frame 344 and terminal dispatch.
candidateAssessments.existingCoverage: not present by canonical config key/action in either merged registry before these 10 batch rows were added

nearMisses.reason: Recasting during Nightsoul returns without a damage root; a constant rule cannot express the status-dependent 0/1 case.
Initial root creates Dreamdrifter cloud attacks; this needs an owned generator/producer closure.
Recast while Blessing is active exits state without a root; constant count cannot express status-dependent 0/1.
Ability queues a delayed task-generated explosion at parameterized illusion_delay (clamped 35..360); producer contract required.
Hit callback creates target-owned Blood Debt tasks that emit delayed attacks; owned task/entity receipts needed.
One direct damaging hit plus zero-damage mark root; damage later emitted from enemy task callback (Lingering Aeon).
Includes zero-damage bubble application and break roots; ordinary bubble detonation is damage caused by later enemy hits, outside plain direct root closure.
Includes one damaging root and one non-damage talisman-application root; global talisman callbacks heal and need distinct accounting.
The method queues a task that launches direct damage and recurring skill ticks; task/owned generator closure required.
Besides direct hit, E creates Itzpapa state; C4 skull callback emits additional damage, requiring owned producer/callback coverage.
Direct hit is followed by a Birgitta summon producer.
The damage root is emitted inside a QueueCharTask after burstHitmark; producer receipt is required.

scopeNotes: Each proposed row counts direct method-owned roots only. It is not a complete character kit or per-rotation total.
The action collection still needs normal terminal dispatch and per-enemy outcomes through the latest branch-specific hit frame; Mona E requires up to frame 344.
Independent weapon/artifact procs, reactions, later actions and triggered character effects stay outside these fragments.
